name: IP2Location.io
summary: IP geolocation with ISP, ASN, usage type, mobile carrier and proxy/fraud data (by plan), plus domain WHOIS records and the domains hosted on an IP.

api_key.description: An IP2Location.io API key (free plan sign-up at ip2location.io). Sent as a Bearer token. IP geolocation works without one; WHOIS and hosted domains need it.

notes: Without a key, geolocation allows 1,000 queries a day, reset at 00:00 UTC; a Free Plan key raises that to 50,000 a month.
Which fields come back depends on the plan: the basic response is location, time zone, ASN and is_proxy; higher plans add ISP, domain, usage type, mobile carrier, proxy details, fraud score and more.

endpoints.name: Geolocate an IP address
endpoints.summary: Country, region, city, coordinates, ZIP code, time zone, ASN and AS name, proxy flag, and on higher plans ISP, domain, net speed, usage type, carrier, currency, language and proxy/fraud details.

ip.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address; the caller's own IP when left out.

lang.description: Translate continent, country, region and city names (Plus and Security plans only; others get error 10004).

endpoints.name: Get a domain's WHOIS record
endpoints.summary: Creation, update and expiry dates, domain age, registrar, registrant, admin, tech and billing contacts, status and nameservers.
notes: Needs an API key, sent as a Bearer token (the key query parameter is the documented alternative).

endpoints.name: List domains hosted on an IP
endpoints.summary: The domain names hosted on an IPv4 or IPv6 address, 100 per page, with the total count.

page.description: Result page, default 1; total_pages says how many there are.

notes: Needs an API key, sent as a Bearer token (the key query parameter is the documented alternative).
